notes.subject: wara / hol wara / wel
notes.rationale: Hibru i usim ol tok bilong wara olsem piksa bilong marit stret — ol man i save tok em i stap hait, tanim tok tasol.

notes.subject: Dringim
notes.rationale: TOK i soim man sapos em i mekim — em i sanguma man long pasin bilong em yet.

notes.subject: ונזלים
notes.rationale: Sampela i tanim olsem 'ol wara i rarap i kam' (klinik), sampela olsem 'ol wara i wok long rarap' — taim i no klia long Hibru.

translation: Dringim wara bilong hol wara bilong yu yet, na ol wara i rarap i kam, long namel bilong ol wel bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: na ol wara i rarap i kam
